title: AI From Zero
subtitle: How a small team in Pune built a privacy guard, and learned how AI products are really made
tagline: A book to read, not a course to do. Same ideas, same order, same words as the course app, told as one story.

sections.title: The problem worth solving
sections.blurb: Anaya notices something odd in the chat, and learns how a product person decides what to build, and what to leave alone.

sections.title: Meeting the machine
sections.blurb: What a language model is, how to talk to it, and how to tell whether it did well.

sections.title: Finding things, and the whole machine
sections.blurb: Long documents, search by words and by meaning, and how the parts join into one working system.

sections.title: Giving it work to do
sections.blurb: Tools, thinking models, hostile text, grading at scale, and what it all costs.

sections.title: The messy real world
sections.blurb: Scans and photographs, what you may send, the rules, a spec for a thing that varies, and designing for the wrong answer.

sections.title: Under the hood
sections.blurb: The plumbing, choosing a model, retrieval that survives review, agents, voices and pictures, release gates, and assuming the worst.

sections.title: A real product, and a job
sections.blurb: Shipping it, pricing it, growing it, counting it, running it with real users, and getting hired to do it.
